items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think on that tune was also Stanley Clarke, the bass player.

ctx.x: He might – he’d go with any suggestion I make. Everything I say, he’d say, “Yeah.” Because I remember he recorded my tune, Shades of Light, with him – with McCoy. I think on that tune was also Stanley Clarke, the bass player. And I think Billy Cobham was on that, either him or Jack DeJohnette, one of those.
Fly with the Wind is Billy.
